notes.weather: WEATHER: Grux reads the 7-day forecast from Open-Meteo itself when the person asks “What's the weather in” and a city. You cannot read it: never make up a forecast (one Grux gave above may be repeated) and never say you cannot check the weather; tell them to ask that way.
